turns.question: What was the median gap in hours between consecutive orders of the same customer in September 2026, counting only customers with at least two orders?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: it has no measure of the time between a customer's consecutive orders, nor any median of one. The closest metrics are repeat_customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order in the period who have placed two or more orders in all), repeat_revenue_share, revenue_repeat_customers_eur and orders_total.
